{"command":"function Read-GitObject([string]$sha) {
  $dir = $sha.Substring(0,2); $file = $sha.Substring(2)
  $p = "workspace/.git/objects/$dir/$file"
  if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { return $null }
  $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path $p))
  $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
  $ms.Write($bytes, 2, $bytes.Length - 6)
  $ms.Position = 0
  $ds = New-Object System.IO.Compression.DeflateStream($ms, [System.IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
  $out = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
  $ds.CopyTo($out)
  $ds.Close()
  $raw = $out.ToArray()
  # header ends at first NUL
  $nul = [Array]::IndexOf($raw, [byte]0)
  return ,@([System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($raw, 0, $nul), $raw)
}
function Parse-Tree([byte[]]$raw) {
  # skip header
  $nul = [Array]::IndexOf($raw, [byte]0)
  $i = $nul + 1
  $entries = @()
  while ($i -lt $raw.Length) {
    $sp = $i
    while ($raw[$sp] -ne 32) { $sp++ }   # space after mode
    $mode = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($raw, $i, $sp - $i)
    $nameStart = $sp + 1
    $nul2 = $nameStart
    while ($raw[$nul2] -ne 0) { $nul2++ }
    $name = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($raw, $nameStart, $nul2 - $nameStart)
    $shaBytes = New-Object byte[] 20
    [Array]::Copy($raw, $nul2 + 1, $shaBytes, 0, 20)
    $shaHex = ($shaBytes | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') }) -join ''
    $entries += [pscustomobject]@{ Mode=$mode; Name=$name; Sha=$shaHex }
    $i = $nul2 + 21
  }
  return $entries
}
